submitted.rationale: XRD at indices 8, 16 and 24 shows trirutile ZnSb2O6-type peaks across the line, with an extra Sb-rich secondary phase at high Sb. EQE under 2.4 eV illumination rose steadily toward the Zn-rich end: index 20 gave 4.3e-4%, index 10 gave 9.1e-4% and index 3 gave 1.7e-3%. All values are very low, as expected for sub-gap excitation. Index 3 was the highest measured.

rejected.reason: Lowest EQE (4.3e-4%); Sb-rich with a secondary phase

rejected.hypothesis: Sb-rich secondary phase adds visible absorption
